name: KiCad Project Manager
description: Edit KiBot metadata, restore a missing workflow, and apply company rules and stackup.
description_full: A native wxPython IPC companion for KiCad 9. Inspect the active project, edit metadata and authors, restore a missing CI workflow from a KiCad template, and select DRAFT/PRELIMINARY/CHECKED. Compare and apply a local standards catalog: company design rules stay in one marked block, and project exceptions outside that block are kept. Stackup updates cover copper, dielectrics, finish, and thickness. Close the PCB and schematic editors before applying standards. Preview changes, with local backups and conflict detection. Enable the KiCad API in Preferences → Plugins. Linux requires Python pip, venv, and distro-provided wxPython.
